title: Lane A weak-lift cause-matrix — H-A1..A4 resolution
signal: paged DEPTH ladder cross-lingual concept-margin lift (composed - frozen, bits), 25 anchors, 5-lang parallel
prior_observation: slope +0.15..+0.43 bits/unit at 25 anchors, sign-unstable across backbone seeds (noise-buried)

H-A1_corpus.tested_by: P1 corpus agent a33223d (out_phase1/result_phase1.json, live AKD1000)
H-A1_corpus.evidence: 10x corpus (250 anchors FLORES-200 5-way) -> lift uniformly NEGATIVE & sign-STABLE: per-N mean N2=-0.837 N3=-0.773 N4=-0.883 N5=-0.811 (N4 std 0.011). 25-anchor weak-positive was small-sample artifact. seed band shrank 0.412->0.213, big_slope_mean=-0.0032. resolution_verdict=COLLAPSE-NULL.
H-A1_corpus.implication: bigger corpus does NOT recover a positive lift; it COLLAPSES it. corpus is not the fix.

H-A2_quantization.evidence: 1/2/3/4-bit per-feature-quantile L1 readout on final paged unit; lift 95%-bootstrap CI straddles 0 at EVERY rung AND EVERY bit-depth. multibit_any_ci_lo_gt0=False. finer readout only widens the band.
H-A2_quantization.implication: the 1-bit readout is not hiding a real lift; quantization is not the bottleneck.

H-A3_plasticity_depth.evidence: depth_gain (lift_twolayer - lift_lastfc) = [-0.656,+0.648,-0.600] N{3,4,5}, mean -0.203, n_pos=1 n_neg=2, sign_consistent=False. 2nd plastic layer adds no consistent lift; gains within per-rung noise (~0.6 bits).

H-A4_native_init_noise_floor.tested_by: ha4_reinit_noise_floor.py (live AKD1000, PID 49501, backbone seed FIXED) + result_ha4_analysis_from_artifacts.json
H-A4_native_init_noise_floor.evidence: backbone-FIXED re-init x3: |mean lift|/reinit_sd = 1.16/1.97/3.10/1.22 (ALL >1), sign_stable across reinit True at every rung. lift CLEARLY EXCEEDS the pure native-init noise band.
H-A4_native_init_noise_floor.correction: the from-artifacts analysis (|mean lift|/seed-sd ~0.9-1.1) CONFLATED backbone-seed noise with chip re-init noise (robustness run varied both). Isolating re-init shows the large variance came from BACKBONE-SEED (corpus-encoding) sensitivity, NOT the chip's identity-noise floor.
H-A4_native_init_noise_floor.implication: the non-determinism that IS the identity does NOT drown the lift. identity-noise is not the floor.

combined_verdict.ruling: ALL FOUR competing causes FALSIFIED on the live AKD1000. The weak/sign-unstable 25-anchor lift is NOT a fixable knob (not corpus-size, not readout-quantization, not plasticity-depth) and NOT a fundamental identity-noise floor (H-A4 shows the lift exceeds chip re-init noise). The dominant remaining axis is BACKBONE-SEED / corpus-ENCODING sensitivity: H-A4 isolated that the lift's instability tracks the backbone seed, and P1 showed that SCALING the corpus drives the lift NEGATIVE (collapse). So the on-chip last-layer Hebbian COMPOSITION does not carry a robust cross-lingual concept-alignment ADVANTAGE at this primitive scale — the paging/composition CAPACITY is GREEN (all rungs learned on chip) but the representational LIFT claim is a closed-negative.
combined_verdict.fixable_or_fundamental: NEITHER a simple fix NOR an identity-noise floor. It is a closed-negative on the lift CLAIM itself: at the AKD1000 1-bit last-layer Hebbian primitive, deep paged composition does not buy a robust cross-lingual margin, and more corpus makes it worse. Confirms P1's COLLAPSE-NULL: the path to a real lift is NOT in any of these four knobs but in a richer learning rule / multi-layer plasticity / different signal than 1-bit Hamming concept-margin (DEFERRED, out of these 4 axes).
combined_verdict.honest_note: This is the valid 'all FALSIFIED' outcome the mission pre-registered. It does NOT confirm P1's corpus path as a FIX (corpus FALSIFIED too); it CONVERGES with P1 on a closed-negative for the lift, isolating backbone/corpus-encoding sensitivity as the descriptive cause while ruling out the three actionable knobs.
